PROJECT JOURNAL / ANDROID DEVELOPMENT

A word game, in reverse.

A simple idea became a hands-on lesson in game logic: show a reversed word, and let the player figure it out.

Leonard S. Dacpano / Personal field notes

Turning an idea into a game

As part of my development practice, I worked on RevWord, an Android word guessing game built with Java and XML layouts in Android Studio. Players read a reversed word and type the correct answer before time runs out.

More than an answer field

The project brought together a countdown timer, score tracking, limited attempts, a pause menu, and a game-over screen. Working through those interactions helped me understand how to manage game state and give players feedback.

Even a small game is a chance to practice state, feedback, and the details that make an application feel interactive.
